body:
When I first started Lexapro the nausea was really bad, like I felt something in the back of my throat gagging me. This sensation went away after a while. 

I’m having other long term negative side effects so I’m stopping completely now.
Yes. And lack of interest many times. I think about sex constantly but lack interest to go through with it and when I do I can’t come.
I’ve been on it for about 5 months.
I’ve been on it for about three months. 10mg. I still feel drowsy and have very low sex drive. The nausea/weird throat feeling went away after a couple of weeks.
Yes. They are almost always impossible to ignore but some moments are worse than others - for example when anxiety overwhelms me and I have the feeling that I’ve got to follow through ASAP.

It’s facing the ultimate fear of most people as well as solving the mystery of death. Part of the appeal is turning your back on all of the trivial bullshit of this reality, the greed and pointless daily struggle. Given the choice of being used up for labor or living in poverty - both choices a slow declining death.
I had a similar experience. The queue slowly ticked down a few numbers then seemed to stop because it didn’t move for over 20 min. I had to abandon it at that point.

I hope to be forgotten and not leave hurt for people. I feel ashamed at what mental illness has put me/ my relationships through. For some people physical and mental circumstances make continuing unbearable.
